subject: general
question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two set of pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

JOL: FRO

MKH: INK
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**JOL : FRO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac38e3e3bec3c45a7f1c6b29ca514b2e92c4d066a9f44be5f16eb98b0e3e840e.png] 

**Pair 2: MKH : INK**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cbd939a2c62ab08bd74e9c66d687d5b751932afef1452403f925058d9f7620f.png] 

**Applying the same logic to the options:**

Option 4: HPD : DSG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd912c4697dd79662145cde84abbc4e350abdb20c5db27dff6e73961c9651742.png] 

This pair follows the same (-4, +3, +3) pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
